title: DiffoR: A Unified Continuous Generative Framework for Universal Ordinal Regression

problem.claim: Ordinal regression predicts target values with inherent order for applications across diverse domains.

gap.claim: Existing ordinal regression paradigms are constrained by quantization artifacts, limited global ordinal topological perception, rigid boundaries, and inadequate modeling of non-stationary semantic transitions.

narrative_sequence.summary: Ordinal regression addresses prediction tasks involving inherently ordered target values.
Although ordinal regression has progressed across regression, classification, and generation paradigms, existing methods retain structural limitations in representing ordinal data.
Rigid boundary delineations fail to capture non-stationary semantic transitions in ordinal data.
